Black Friday is a great time to expand your game library because it’s a chance to catch deals that aren’t normally happening throughout the year. That’s true for Nintendo Switch 2 games, as well. In addition to a $50 off sale on one of its console bundles , Nintendo is also knocking $20 off some of the Switch 2’s best titles. Some of the most notable games include Donkey Kong Bananza , which is $49.99 (usually $69.99) at Amazon , Target , and Best Buy , and Super Mario Party Jamboree Plus Jamboree TV for $59.99 (usually $79.99) at Amazon , Walmart , and Best Buy . Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, and GameStop are offering discounts on several more Switch 2 games, though their respective end times and availability varies. Nintendo shared that some game sales will end on November 29th. Even if deals dry up for physical games on your wishlist, digital game deals are happening through Nintendo’s eShop until 11:59 PM PT on Wednesday, December 2nd, 2026. The instrumentation on Khudgarzi draws on traditional South Asian music, including Carnatic and Hindustani styles, but also dabbles in Arabic folk traditions, as well as modern Western electronic music. Trip-hop flourishes and Spaghetti Western guitar brush up against tanbur and ghatam. For a limited time, Nintendo has knocked $50 off one of its two current console bundles, temporarily rolling back the $50 price increase that went into effect in early September. It’s tough to predict which bundle will be most popular for your household. The Mario Kart World bundle runs $499.99 (previously $549.99) and includes the console, a digital copy of the aforementioned game, and three months of Nintendo Switch Online. Then there’s the Nintendo Switch Sports Resort bundle for $529.99 (price unchanged for Black Friday), which includes the more recent minigame-filled title instead. Both are currently available from Amazon , Best Buy , Walmart , and Nintendo . Nintendo Switch 2 + Mario Kart World Bundle Where to Buy: $549.99 $499.99 at Amazon $549.99 $499 at Walmart $549.99 $499.99 at Best Buy Nintendo has delivered hit after hit since the console launched in mid-2025.
